title: Data Producer Consumer Profile v1
summary: A module that produces, consumes, validates, transforms, shares, or analyzes datasets and streams.

integration_points.name: data_shape
integration_points.description: Files, records, fields, types, units, and stream semantics.

integration_points.name: lineage
integration_points.description: Inputs, transforms, outputs, parameters, and reproducibility.

integration_points.name: data_policy
integration_points.description: Privacy, retention, sharing, access, and export constraints.

checks: Fields declare names, types, units, and sensitivity where applicable.
Files and record counts are discoverable.
Lineage links inputs, transforms, and outputs.
Privacy, rights, and retention are declared for shared data.
Quality metrics or validation reports are linked when available.

agent_guidance: Use this profile when independent modules exchange data.
Treat fields and provenance as public integration surfaces.
Report changed fields, source data, privacy behavior, and validation.
